rust_locations: crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:class body envelope accounting for painted clusters
invariant: USymbolStack paints a transparent inset URectangle and an outer UPath. LimitFinder measures the rectangle even though its color is none: its minimum is translated by (-1,-1), while its maximum is width-1,height-1 and remains inside the outer path. SvekResult therefore normalizes a stack cluster from minY one unit above the outer path, moves the complete solved body down by one unit, and expands the final unscaled vertical extent by one unit.
causal_divergence: Rust package_cluster_painted_min falls through to the outer path origin for stack clusters, so normalize_svek_package_envelope omits the inset rectangle's one-unit minY frontier. The whole cluster and its children remain one base unit too high and the root canvas is one base unit too short; the checker exposes the same model error as 1.625px under scale 1.625 and 1.5px under dpi 144.
planned_change: Model Stack's LimitFinder frontier directly in package_cluster_painted_min as minX unchanged and minY minus the existing LIMIT_FINDER_RECTANGLE_INSET. Include that same painted minimum in body-top accounting while retaining the outer path as the maximum. Do not derive any value from scaled checker coordinates; generic SVG scaling remains downstream.

scope_boundary: This mechanism owns only the stack cluster's LimitFinder minimum and resulting SVEK/body normalization. It does not alter corner geometry, stroke state, symbol dimensions, title/content margins, child Graphviz layout, generic SVG scaling, comparator behavior, baselines, or fixture eligibility.
